**MOTH Chess 2.0.1** adds on-board suggestions for **Chess.com games against the computer** (`chess.com/play/computer`), so you can test MOTH against Chess.com's bots. Those games are unrated and have no human opponent.

Nothing else changes in fair play:
- Online, daily, tournament, arena and puzzle pages remain blocked.
- Any page showing a running clock is still blocked, including bot games played with a clock.

To upgrade: replace the `moth-chess-dist` folder and press reload in `brave://extensions`. If you had already allowed chess.com, the new page is covered automatically.
